scripts.tunnel-url: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('tunnel_url.txt')) { const data = fs.readFileSync('tunnel_url.txt'); const txt = data.includes(0) ? data.toString('utf16le') : data.toString('utf8'); const matches = [...txt.matchAll(/https:\/\/[a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.lhr\.life/g)]; if (matches.length) { console.log('Active Tunnel URL:', matches[matches.length - 1][0]); } else { console.log('No active tunnel URL found.'); } } else { console.log('tunnel_url.txt not found.'); }"
